## Notebook submission checklist

Thank you for contributing to NeurodeskEDU! Please confirm the following before requesting a review.

### Notebook quality

- [ ] I started from the [`template.ipynb`](https://github.com/neurodesk/neurodeskedu) and kept the standard metadata, `watermark`, and `module load` sections.
- [ ] I restarted the kernel and ran all cells from top to bottom without errors before submitting.
- [ ] My notebook uses an openly available dataset and cites it with a DOI or permanent link.
- [ ] I have read the [Design Principles](https://github.com/neurodesk/neurodeskedu#design-principles) and my notebook follows them.

### Terms of submission

- [ ] **I have read and agree to the [Terms of Submission](https://github.com/neurodesk/neurodeskedu/blob/main/TERMS_OF_SUBMISSION.md).** In particular, I understand that:
  - a peer review will be initiated after publication (publication is not delayed by the review);
  - a review-status badge will appear on my notebook;
  - I am expected to respond to reviewer comments within ~15 days;
  - Neurodesk may make maintenance edits to keep the notebook functional and conformant; and
  - if I do not respond to reviewers, Neurodesk may create a successor notebook citing mine as the starting point.
